request.style: English, male solo voice with gospel choir, acoustic guitar, organ, drums, bass guitar, warm majestic mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sons of Ulla stand in the light
Arah and Hanniel keep the sight
Rizia walks where the promise leads
Heads of the fathers in their needs
Chosen men from the tribe of Asher
Mighty warriors who will never falter

[Chorus]
Twenty-six thousand for the fight
Leaders among the leaders bright
Enrolled for service in the war
The tribe of Asher stands once more
Heads of their houses, strong and true
The chosen men the people knew

[Verse]
Fifth lot came out for the clan
Territory marked as the law ran
Helkath and Hali in the land
Acshaph stands by their own command
Allammelech and Amad too
Mishal sees what the borders do
West to Carmel and Shihor Libnath
East to Beth Dagon and the path

[Chorus]
Twenty-six thousand for the fight
Leaders among the leaders bright
Enrolled for service in the war
The tribe of Asher stands once more
Heads of their houses, strong and true
The chosen men the people knew

[Bridge]
Zebulun border and the valley deep
Iphtah El where the people keep
Beth Emek and Neiel on the rise
Cabul on the left side in the skies
Ebron and Rehob and Hammon town
Kanah near the Greater Sidon ground

[Verse]
Ramah turns to the city strong
Tyre is fortified, the right is wrong
Hosah turns to the sea so wide
Aczib where the waters glide
Ummah and Aphek and Rehob near
Twenty-two towns without a fear

[Chorus]
Twenty-six thousand for the fight
Leaders among the leaders bright
Enrolled for service in the war
The tribe of Asher stands once more
Heads of their houses, strong and true
The chosen men the people knew

[Outro]
Inheritance of Asher clan by clan
The land is given in the hand
Of the chosen men and their fathers' name
Remembered in the holy frame
